# NHPI-OSA-Burden

Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/NHPI-OSA-Burden
Primary article: Severity, comorbidities, and adherence to therapy in Native Hawaiians/Pacific Islanders with obstructive sleep apnea
DOI: https://doi.org/10.5664/jcsm.10472
Journal record: https://jcsm.aasm.org/doi/10.5664/jcsm.10472
PubMed: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36727487/
PMC: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10152360/
PMID: 36727487
PMCID: PMC10152360

## Purpose

Stata workflow for the NHPI obstructive sleep apnea burden paper. The script loads a restricted chart-review Excel workbook, derives demographic, comorbidity, sleep-study, symptom, and PAP-adherence variables, then creates aggregate tables, figures, and adherence regression outputs.

## Public Files

- `README.md`: human-facing project overview, run command, data restrictions, citation, and license.
- `PI Stats - Final.do`: main Stata analysis script.
- `CITATION.cff`: structured repository and article citation metadata.
- `data_dictionary.md` and `data_dictionary.csv`: expected workbook variables and derived fields.
- `AGENTS.md`: repository-specific instructions for coding agents.
- Root `.eps`, `.gph`, and `table 1*.xlsx` files: historical aggregate publication artifacts.

## Restricted Input

Do not commit the source workbook or row-level derived datasets. Default expected input:

- `data/private/Pacific Islander Data New - ESS.xlsx`
- sheet: `all`

The script also accepts an explicit workbook path and output root:

```stata
do "PI Stats - Final.do" "path/to/Pacific Islander Data New - ESS.xlsx" "outputs/stata"
```

## Run Command

```stata
do "PI Stats - Final.do"
```

Batch example:

```bash
stata-mp -b do "PI Stats - Final.do"
```

Outputs are written under `outputs/stata/<date>/` by default. Full execution requires the restricted local workbook.

## Data And License Boundaries

Repository code and documentation are MIT licensed. Restricted clinical data, source workbooks, row-level derived outputs, third-party materials, and publisher-formatted article files are excluded. Link the DOI, PubMed, and PMC records instead of copying full article text into this repository.

## Citation

Preferred article citation: Locke BW, Sundar DJ, Ryujin D. Severity, comorbidities, and adherence to therapy in Native Hawaiians/Pacific Islanders with obstructive sleep apnea. J Clin Sleep Med. 2023;19(5):967-974. doi:10.5664/jcsm.10472.

Use `CITATION.cff` for structured citation metadata and cite the repository commit or release used.

## Agent Cautions

- Treat the source workbook and all row-level exports as restricted.
- Do not regenerate root-level historical artifacts from private data without explicit review.
- Keep generated outputs in ignored `outputs/stata/`.
- Preserve legacy analysis logic unless a change is explicitly scientific.
- Validate CFF, README fences, and dictionary coverage before publishing changes.
